notes: Procedure: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-phase2-harness.md, "Evidence classes and the classification rule", read per clause. A clause runs on a38dbca when it needs no clock advance, no injected timing, no core-crate hook and no contract addition, its observable is a contract member #286 has, a model row, #286's views over the QML stand-in, or the fake's records, and the harness reaches it by a positive wait.

The transport is not reachable through QML. Its own outcomes (reply, failure, status code, token, socket-absent flag, event, started, ended) are outside-module. The request bytes it sends are not: the fake records them when a backend pass or action sends them, as R-HTTP-01 renders its criterion through the opening pass.

Values of one published snapshot are read once a positive wait has seen that snapshot (a value or a change signal), because the contract stores everything before it announces anything (R-UI-06, R-WATCH-11). A negative, an unchanged value or an exact count where more could still arrive needs the read, idle or retry barrier, so it is deferred.
A deferred clause of a parity requirement is cpp-suite when Table B maps #286 tests to the requirement, and names those tests; otherwise it is phase3-only with its reason.

pr names the Phase 2 PR whose scenarios run the clauses: 306 (this one), 307 (R-HTTP, R-PARSE, R-GROUP), 308 (R-WATCH, R-CONN, R-WRITE, R-UI, R-SEC, the backend half of R-FAKE-03) or 309 (views and view halves). A later PR may move an entry only by editing this file, with the reason in its commit message.
